I've implemented JWT authentication for the API instead of extending the existing cookie-based session system in ApplicationController. The SessionManager service was tightly coupled to the Rails session store, so reusing it would have required a significant refactor.

I chose a 15-minute access token with a 7-day refresh token stored in an httpOnly cookie. The refresh token is persisted in the user_refresh_tokens table so we can revoke individual devices. I considered using Redis for token storage but the existing PostgreSQL setup with the TokenRotation concern handles the load fine for our scale.
